rollback.notificationChannel: Manual beta escalation channel agreed by Filip; private Telegram/Discord/email endpoint is not stored in release artifacts.
triggers: Any release-blocker regression in playback, cast handoff, or data integrity.
Provider overload, 429/5xx escalation, or startup/failure SLO breach during beta enrollment.
Any evidence of catch-up playback using local ffmpeg, server-side transcode/remux, generated HLS, proxy-remuxed, remux-hls, or XUI-side media processing.
steps: Stop beta enrollment and switch release recommendation to no-go.
Keep catch-up failures on provider-direct/proxy-normalized playback or unsupported overlay; do not enable transcode/remux workaround.
Re-deploy last known good build or roll back the PR if web regressions are introduced.
Re-run provider preflight, compatibility matrix slices, capacity artifact validation, and no-media-processing audit before resuming enrollment.
verificationChecks: Manual browser/network audit and no-media evidence scanner remain free of __remux__, remux, remux-hls, ffmpeg, ffprobe, transcode, proxy-remuxed, generated-HLS, and XUI-side media-processing hits.
Compatibility matrix has no release-blocker failures and pending target evidence is explicitly triaged.
Beta capacity artifact validates and final signoff remains blocked until owner evidence is complete.
rollback.notes: Rollback/throttle owner and notification channel are recorded. Overall readiness remains pending while go/no-go, real-device/target matrix, and deployed Lumen edge capacity evidence are open.

signoff.notes: Owner/performance/ops/runtime/security blockers are closed. Overall readiness remains pending until go/no-go, real-device target matrix, design parity, smoke/compatibility target evidence, and deployed Lumen edge capacity evidence are complete.
